newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sept coffee exports 1.14 mln bags - FEBEC.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sept coffee exports 1.14 mln bags - FEBEC.

text.p: Brazilian coffee exports in September reached 1.14 million 60-kg bags, down from 1.54 million bags in August, the Brazilian Coffee Exporters' Federation (FEBEC) said in a statement.
The September figure is also down from the 1.28 million bags shipped in the same month last year, according to FEBEC statistics.

FEBEC's president said yesterday September shipments would be around 1.2 million bags, slightly below expectations, because of a delay in scrapping a state export tax which had caused exporters to hold back sales in expectation of its approval.

However he said that shipments in October would probably be well above 1.5 million bags as they would include exports not made in September because of the bureaucratic delay over the so-called ICMS tax exemption.
